file_class: [1] hand-written Step-11 BRAM replay path contract
validation_rules: The pin-agnostic Step-11 composition shall instantiate exactly one source/core integration owner and one logical telemetry/HPS owner, with no second mathematical core.

The Step-11 profile and reset default shall select TSRC_BRAM_REPLAY, while the pin-agnostic composition shall preserve the generated CSR source-mode commit path and shall not invent a hardware profile lock.

A raw explicit replay-start request shall reach the source owner independently of admission; admission shall require STATUS-only transport readiness, an idle writer with no queued FIFO record, and no E2E epoch in flight, and every denied explicit start shall emit reject evidence.

An accepted replay start shall flush only uncommitted packetizer/FIFO state through external_telemetry_flush_i; it shall never assert external_transport_clear_i or reset committed producer, consumer, or sequence state.

HPS TELEMETRY_SOFT_RESET shall remain transport-only under the frozen control contract; dedicated board KEY[3] shall abort and rearm only source/core/E2E state without flushing telemetry or changing writer/ring state, KEY[2] shall retain its frozen ADC manual-request role, and the next accepted replay may flush uncommitted telemetry only after transport_epoch_idle admission.
Periodic STATUS requests shall be suppressed while replay is busy; replay_path_done_pulse shall request the single replay-correlated post-core STATUS record used by the E2E supervisor.
replay_done_o shall retain the narrow source-token meaning and shall never be used by itself as exact end-to-end replay completion.

replay_path_done_o shall require replay_done_o, structural quiescence, every frozen Ny, tau_last, and Nframes count including the public core_error_sample_count and replay-epoch metric commit count, contiguous accepted y indices, and no replay/core fault, but shall cover only BRAM source through core y.

replay_e2e_done_o shall be the Step-11 end-to-end completion authority and shall require a new post-core-path STATUS record normal-committed to DDR, producer and DMA count advance, writer idle, and no replay/core/telemetry/DDR fault or drop.
An early source completion, undercount, overcount, repeated or skipped y index, mode change, or stage fault shall set completion error and shall never produce a false path-done result.
The failed replay epoch shall remain busy until explicit clear or reset so an error cannot silently turn into PASS or restart itself.
The board profile shall remain the zero_Ns4096_thr0 BRAM replay profile with Ns=4096, Ny=4608, Nframes=33, THR2=0, and STATUS-only telemetry.
The Step-11 RTL regression source shall use impulse_Ns1024_thr0 with Ns=1024, Ny=1536, Nframes=9, THR2=0, and the pin-agnostic replay-system top.

The impulse regression shall compare every accepted y sample and index, observe exact replay_path_done, then wait for replay_e2e_done after the STATUS DDR commit rather than treating source-done or core-path-done alone as full test completion.
The impulse regression shall rely exclusively on replay_path_done_pulse auto-injection for its post-core STATUS request and shall not manually pulse status_tick after path completion.
Real mathematical-core sample, frame, and unique-bin taps shall feed trecap_de1soc_full_top and trecap_telemetry_top without a synthetic replacement.
Telemetry records shall traverse the packet FIFO, HPS bridge, DDR ring writer, Avalon-MM write master, Platform Designer F2SDRAM boundary, and HPS DDR3 pins.

The Avalon-MM write master shall permit at most one outstanding beat and shall not emit record write-done until the final beat receives a successful response; the physical wrapper local OKAY proves only legal bridge acceptance because the generated F2SDRAM interface has no downstream response channel, while local range rejection shall return SLVERR and shall never advance the producer pointer.
The pin-agnostic Step-11 regression shall inject delayed OKAY and SLVERR beat responses and shall prove that a response error cannot produce a normal commit or E2E done.
Physical-board E2E completion shall mean successful local HPS/F2SDRAM bridge acceptance only and shall not be presented as physical DRAM durability or downstream DRAM error evidence.

The E2E supervisor shall latch faults and transport clear on both the accepted-start edge and the following baseline-capture cycle so no one-cycle failure can disappear through a baseline blind window.

replay_e2e_done shall be retained historical terminal evidence for its correlated replay/STATUS epoch rather than live global transport health; terminal success shall have no correlated Avalon-MM response outstanding.

A later unrelated periodic transport fault shall use the normal transport fault/status channels and shall not retroactively alter a completed epoch result; a new accepted epoch or the defined source/core clear/rearm shall invalidate the retained result.
Telemetry, packet FIFO, DDR writer, HPS, or Platform Designer backpressure shall never control source/core readiness or the mathematical y stream.
The physical board indicators shall distinguish source/core path completion from the stronger Step-11 telemetry-to-DDR end-to-end completion and shall never label replay_done as board PASS.
The uploaded reference archive SHA-256 is an observation only; the checked-in tree still records an unmatched embedded proxy with unverified source provenance.
Zero and impulse artifacts in this milestone are development-smoke inputs only and shall not be presented as reference-model signoff authority.
The source-only checker shall work without jsonschema and shall not invoke an RTL simulator, Platform Designer, Quartus, TimeQuest, or board hardware.
All RTL compile, functional, Platform Designer generation, Quartus, timing, hardware replay, DDR/HPS capture, and hardware-signoff evidence fields shall remain false until those gates actually run.
